notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b003:l001: Continues p43's widow-and-orphan object; no new heading or duplicated context verse.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b003:l002: Кыямат world beyond/Judgment and next verse арбак spirit refer to the dead friend; their source order is preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b003:l004: Father's-grave imprecation retained as a curse in reported speech, not translator commentary.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b003:l006: The hollow/ravine metaphor is rendered literally; no unverified explanation of the proverbial image is added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b003:l016: Baychoro is retained as printed; no silent identification with Bakai.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b004:l001: Sunset here and dawn two verses later both retained; chronology not harmonized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b004:l008: Qibla is the Islamic direction of prayer; no modern geographic bearing is imposed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b004:l022: Кулун literally colt is the customary child epithet, used here within an enemy's order to kill Semetey.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b004:l026: Даңгыт denotes a great male dog/wolf, not Tangut people. Yudakhin and 1969 dictionary: https://el-sozduk.kg/даңгыт/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0044:b004:l032: Exact idiom зың-зың этип кенебейт means remaining quite unconcerned. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/зың/; no literal ringing or invented resolve.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b003:l006: Тумардан чыккан ок болду: тумар normally amulet, but the relation to the projectile and the subsequent lung penetration is not securely resolved. No invented weapon or magic event, and no silent тумар/туман substitution. Whole verse unresolved. Completion-first first pass: Best-effort rendering from a close formulaic parallel; retain for specialist review because the source was previously unresolved.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b003:l018: Whip-length measurement concerns division of cloth, not a new attack upon a person.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b003:l021: Khakan is the imperial title in the Beijing epithet, retained without identifying a modern state.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b003:l025: Four paired provisions for orphans, widows, blind and disabled people remain distinct verses.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b003:l036: Кундуз is otter in Yudakhin, not beaver: https://tamgasoft.kg/dict/index.php?lfrom=kg&word=кундуз. Fur context retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b003:l038: Багалак/багалек is the trouser cuff here; Yudakhin gives an exact otter-fur cuff example: https://el-sozduk.kg/багалек/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b004:l013: Seven pack camels here and six hundred later are retained as printed, without numerical reconciliation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b004:l019: Жакут is rendered ruby in the treasure list; the glossary asterisk remains in source evidence only.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b004:l026: Урдуу is the нурдуу variant meaning radiant/charming, not merely a cheek reference. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/урдуу/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b004:l030: Kanykey is thirty-two; the following forty-day interval concerns Manas's death. Neither is the child's age.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b004:l033: Калдайган кара баш retains great dark head; no unsupported bowed posture is added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b004:l035: Тул is the mourning effigy of the deceased, not a coffin. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/tul-7/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0045:b004:l039: Aktinte is retained as a named weapon; no extra verse is created for the name.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0046:b003:l024: The wives' sons are understood from the brothers' dispute; English supplies the familial relation, not new characters.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0046:b003:l026: Казгалдак is a wild duck; exact species not selected. Yudakhin and 1969 epic example: https://el-sozduk.kg/казгалдак/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0046:b003:l027: Kara-Kyr is retained as a place name without a speculative modern location.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0046:b003:l028: Köbösh directly insults Kanykey, pairing the epithet with bitch and demanding remarriage while assaulting her. Replace literal black-faced with hostile shameless, not bereaved. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Sources: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json.
